## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint`, `bun x tsc --noEmit` and `bun run test` are green
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit: `type(scope): summary` (`!` for a breaking change)
- [ ] Texts exist in both languages; the user guide (`docs/guide`, English and German) and the developer docs (`docs/dev`) are updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] If it applies: migration and seed, permission provisioning, `icons:build`, `docs:api`. See the [checklists](docs/dev/contributing.md#checklists)
